recipe.visualDefinition: A four-quadrant grid featuring a stylized, high-contrast portrait of a man shouting. Each quadrant uses a different vibrant background color and applies rainbow-colored diagonal or concentric stripes across the figure, utilizing a thick, painterly impasto texture throughout.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of the central figure across four distinct color palettes
Contrast between flat graphic shapes and heavy physical paint texture
Integration of rainbow bands as both a fill pattern and a compositional element
Balance between the dark, high-contrast facial features and the saturated background hues
coreInvariants: Visible impasto brushstrokes and palette knife marks
Saturated primary and secondary color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single male figure centered in each quadrant, cropped from the waist up, occupying approximately 70% of each frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open, shouting mouth of the figure, which provides a dark focal point in every panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A Z-pattern starting from the top-left yellow panel, moving across to the pink, down to the brown, and ending at the black panel with concentric arcs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the backgrounds are solid but textured, pushing the figure forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Background fields (Yellow, Magenta, Ochre, Black) define the mood of each quadrant.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark shadows define the facial features and silhouette edges.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow spectrum (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet) used for body fills and radiating arcs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with extreme value contrast between the highlights and the deep black shadows of the face.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast modern serif with thick verticals and thin horizontals
Secondary text uses a loose, hand-drawn marker script style
Text is placed along the horizontal axis dividing the top and bottom quadrants
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the serif font features a distinctive curved leg
The script text has irregular, organic baseline shifts
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between formal, rigid serif and informal, expressive script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif look of the primary text.
Matches the casual, hand-drawn aesthetic of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x2 grid of a man shouting. Top-left: yellow background, teal figure with rainbow stripes. Top-right: pink background, orange figure with rainbow stripes. Bottom-left: brown background, green figure with rainbow stripes. Bottom-right: black background, red figure with concentric rainbow arcs. Apply a heavy impasto oil paint texture across all panels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, black Modern Serif title in the bottom-left of the top-left panel. Add a gold, hand-drawn script subtitle in the bottom-right of the top-right panel.

verificationChecks: Does each panel have a distinct background color?
Is the impasto texture visible and thick?
Are the rainbow stripes present on the figures?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure rainbow elements are integrated into the figure
Confirm heavy impasto texture is applied globally
Check that text is positioned on the horizontal axis
recipe.reuseFormula: Pop Art Grid + Impasto Texture + Rainbow Stripes + High-Contrast Portrait
